label_meanings.execution: visible evidence supports a concrete attack-relevant operation against a target, object, endpoint, file, process, database action, or network action
label_meanings.preparation: visible evidence supports a pre-action function such as probing, reachability checking, access-path exploration, target/service identification, configuration or credential checking, or positioning before a concrete operation
label_meanings.result: visible evidence supports an observable downstream effect of attack activity, such as returned-content proxy, response-completion effect, delivered data, artifact creation or modification, state change, exfiltration/send effect, or comparable post-operation consequence
label_meanings.stage_unclosed: attack-related but visible evidence does not safely close preparation, execution, or result
